2607.28170.title: Search Strategies for Optimal Classification and Regression Trees
2607.28170.paper_summary: Optimal decision trees (ODTs) are compact, interpretable machine learning models that globally optimize a given objective, but their scalability remains challenging. While recent work has proposed a variety of search strategies to improve scalability, the precise contribution of each strategy remains unclear. To address this gap, we introduce a general algorithmic framework for ODTs that instantiates previously used search strategies and enables the definition of new ones. This provides a common lens through which to understand and compare different strategies, which we use to empirically investigate the effect of 18 search strategies. Compared to the state of the art, the best strategy in our evaluation achieves significantly better anytime performance for classification, and improves runtime by more than an order of magnitude for regression.
2607.28170.paper_summary_zh: 最佳決策樹（ODTs）是緊湊且可解釋的機器學習模型，能夠全球優化給定的目標，但其可擴展性仍然面臨挑戰。雖然最近的研究提出了多種搜索策略以改善可擴展性，但每種策略的具體貢獻仍不明確。為了解決這一空白，我們引入了一個通用的ODT算法框架，該框架實現了先前使用的搜索策略並支持定義新的策略。這提供了一個共同的視角，以理解和比較不同的策略，我們利用這一視角實證調查了18種搜索策略的效果。與最先進的技術相比，我們評估中的最佳策略在分類任務中實現了顯著更好的隨時性能，並在回歸任務中將運行時間提高了超過一個量級。
